narrative.overview: Use a calm cyan workspace, teal outlines, and yellow actions to make saving and finding references feel approachable. Rounded display type and an original knowledge companion give the interface its character; compact collection tools keep the daily task in focus.
keyCharacteristics: Cool surfaces, readable teal ink, and warm action accents.
Outlined controls with short, solid shadows.
Expressive headings paired with compact, practical UI text.
A decorative companion that yields space to the task on mobile.

rules.name: The Shared Theme Rule
rules.body: Switch semantic properties on the root `data-theme` attribute so every surface, field, dialog, and feedback state follows the theme together. The `dark-` tokens replace their light counterparts; accent, accent-hover, and on-accent remain shared. Use the paired foreground and background roles together.

rules.name: The Editable Text Rule
rules.body: At widths up to 767px, keep editable inputs, textareas, and selects at 16px, including card category controls.

rules.name: The Feedback Motion Rule
rules.body: Keep motion attached to a state change: 180ms control transitions, a small hover lift, and brief toast or menu arrival. Skeleton breathing runs three times. Honor reduced motion across transitions, animations, and scrolling.

dos: **Do** use semantic color properties so light and dark themes stay coherent.
**Do** pair rounded Fredoka headings with Plus Jakarta Sans UI text.
**Do** preserve visible focus, mobile editable text sizes, and recoverable loading, empty, and error states.
**Do** use the original companion as decoration and preserve the mobile task priority.
donts: **Don't** replace the outlined, solid-shadow controls with generic gradients.
**Don't** copy the reference site's event branding or mascot.
**Don't** present synthetic screenshot fixtures as product data or claims.
